latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of MeshLink 服务发布 Skill.

- Enables publishing local services to a group intranet via ZTM (Zero Trust Mesh) using meshlink CLI.
- Guides users through a strict, step-by-step workflow: port confirmation, agent and port checks, service name suggestion, publish preview, explicit user confirmation, and publication.
- Provides clear error handling (agent errors, port checks, name conflicts).
- Outputs detailed previews and publish results for user confirmation at each stage.
- Prohibits publishing without explicit confirmation and enforces all checks using meshlink CLI only.
